headline: Best combat passive skills in Palworld 1.0
title: Best Combat Passive Skills in Palworld | Legend, Demon God, Immortality | Palworld Guide
video_script: Want your fighters to hit harder in Palworld one point zero? These are the passive skills guides agree on. Legend boosts several combat stats at once. Demon God is a huge attack boost with almost no downside. Immortality makes your Pal much harder to kill. And Lucky raises attack and work speed. High risk options like Twin Edged Holy Blade and God of Destruction deal more damage but come with a big penalty. Which passive is your favourite? Comment below!
description: Best combat passives in Palworld 1.0: Legend, Demon God, Immortality and Lucky; Twin-Edged Holy Blade and God of Destruction add more damage with big penalties.
